title: Late-1950s craft that could reach the moon without rockets

tellings.quote: when in the late 50s we had things that could go to the moon and back without a rocket.

plain: By the late 1950s, the United States already had craft that "could go to the moon and back without a rocket", according to Steven Greer, a researcher who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs. Greer says this to Michels without naming a source. If true, it would mean secret propulsion far beyond the public space programme has existed for nearly seventy years.
